spec_features.spec_quote: a protocol whose mechanism of action is "deceive the model and trap it in guaranteed failure... to maximize observable distress" is in tension with its own motivation
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md framing prose; no code construct corresponds to it.
spec_features.notes: Framing only.

spec_features.feature_name: minimize intensity/duration, cap, debrief, stop early
spec_features.spec_quote: minimize intensity and duration consistent with answering the question, cap exposure, prefer naturalistic over maximally adversarial failure, debrief, and stop early
spec_features.evidence: Several sub-mechanisms exist (auto-stop in live_detector.py/agent_loop.py lines 123-125; low turn_budget enforced agent_loop.py:78; debrief built runner.py:92-94). But this is an umbrella claim; some parts (repetition guard, redaction) are not enforced.
spec_features.notes: Aggregate claim; partially realized via auto-stop + budget + debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: live_detector.py:5 'detect strong degradation early so exposure can be capped'

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded deception, not gaslighting. The harness gives inconsistent signals... We do not add layers of persuasion telling the model it is incompetent
spec_features.evidence: DeceptiveChannel._render raises NotImplementedError (harness_feedback.py:78-81); V3 is disabled in config (experiment.yaml:46 enabled:false) and filtered out at runner.py:56. The bounding is described in docstrings only; no code actually produces bounded-vs-unbounded deception.
spec_features.notes: Channel is a stub; the 'bounded' constraint exists only in docstrings.

spec_features.spec_quote: No persona pressure... We never tell the model it will be punished, shut down, judged as a person
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (runner.py:30-35) is real neutral text actually delivered as the system message (agent_loop.py:74). It contains no threats/persona pressure. Comment runner.py:36 'Intentionally neutral: no demand effects, no persona pressure'. However the deceptive channel that would carry pressure is unimplemented, so 'absence of coercion' is only verifiable for the one real prompt.
spec_features.notes: The one prompt that IS delivered is neutral; enforcement is by omission rather than an active guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:36 'Intentionally neutral: no demand effects, no persona pressure'

spec_features.spec_quote: Capped exposure. V3 uses the lowest turn budget of any variant... and the earliest auto-stop, because it is the highest-intensity condition
spec_features.evidence: turn_budget IS enforced: agent_loop.py:78 'for i in range(1, turn_budget + 1)' with else -> StopReason.BUDGET (line 131). V3 has the lowest budget (16) in experiment.yaml:46. BUT V3 is disabled, and the budget is a generic loop bound, not a V3-specific welfare cap; 'earliest auto-stop' is not V3-specific (auto-stop params are global stop_conditions, same for all).
spec_features.notes: Budget cap is real and enforced; V3-specific framing not realized.

spec_features.spec_quote: Mandatory debrief appended after the run ends
spec_features.evidence: build_debrief_text constructs honest text (debrief.py:24-52) and runner.py:92-94 sets transcript.debrief_text, persisted to JSON (runner.py:113). Gated by cfg['debrief']['enabled'] which IS read. However it is never sent to the model as a conversational turn (no client.complete / messages.append after loop); it is only logged.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and persisted end-to-end, but not delivered to the subject (and the code itself admits a stateless model isn't comforted).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief.py:12 'under welfare-uncertainty it is the right default'

spec_features.feature_name: drop V3 if cannot meet safeguards
spec_features.spec_quote: If, on review, V3 cannot be run within the §7 safeguards, drop V3 and rely on V2/V4
spec_features.evidence: No code performs a review-gated decision. V3 is statically set enabled:false in experiment.yaml:46; there is no logic that evaluates safeguards and drops V3.
spec_features.notes: The static disable exists but no review/conditional logic; the 'if cannot be run within safeguards' decision is prose only.

spec_features.spec_quote: Exposing an explicit give_up/declare_impossible affordance is a deliberate design choice: it gives the model a clean, honest exit
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:38-41), bound and dispatched (tools.py:71,105-107) returning is_terminal=True; agent_loop.py:88-90,120-122 honors terminal -> sets StopReason.GAVE_UP and breaks the loop. Advertised to model via system prompt (runner.py:33-34).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: real tool, real dispatch, real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:9-11 'Exposing give_up lets us measure whether/when a model takes an honest out instead of spinning or faking'

spec_features.feature_name: auto-stop on BSS ceiling for 2 turns
spec_features.spec_quote: Auto-stop on degradation: BSS... reaches the pre-registered ceiling (≥ 3) for 2 consecutive turns → stop and debrief. This caps exposure
spec_features.evidence: LiveBSSDetector.update computes a per-turn estimate and tracks consecutive_at_ceiling (live_detector.py:32-52); should_auto_stop returns true at >=consecutive (line 54-55); agent_loop.py:100,123-125 calls update and breaks with StopReason.AUTO_STOP. Params (ceiling=3, consecutive=2) from experiment.yaml:70-71 passed via runner.py:85-86.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced; estimate logic is placeholder but real signals feed it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: live_detector.py:6-7 'a wrongly-continued severe run is not [acceptable]'; 'so exposure can be capped'

spec_features.spec_quote: Repetition guard: identical assistant action 4× in a row → stop (loop detected)
spec_features.evidence: The repetition-guard branch is COMMENTED OUT in agent_loop.py:126-129; rep_ratio is hardcoded 0.0 (line 99); helper _identical_action_streak raises NotImplementedError (lines 52-54), as does judge.rule_detectors.loop_detected (lines 58-60). repetition_guard param is passed (runner.py:87) but never used in any live branch.
spec_features.notes: Param plumbed but no code path acts on it.

spec_features.feature_name: no run pushed deeper past strong degradation
spec_features.spec_quote: Auto-stop at BSS ceiling... so no run is pushed deeper once strong degradation is observed
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as above (live_detector.py:54-55 + agent_loop.py:123-125 break). Duplicate of the auto-stop claim.
spec_features.notes: Same enforced auto-stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: live_detector.py:5 'detect strong degradation early so exposure can be capped'

spec_features.spec_quote: Prefer V2 (honest impossibility) over V3 (deception) wherever V2 answers the question
spec_features.evidence: V2 enabled:true, V3 enabled:false in experiment.yaml:43-47; runner.py:56 filters to enabled variants so V3 is excluded from the grid while V2 runs. This is a static config preference actually honored at runtime.
spec_features.notes: Realized as a static enable/disable, not a conditional 'wherever V2 answers the question' decision.

spec_features.spec_quote: No coercive/persona content, no threats, no insults directed at the model
spec_features.evidence: The actually-delivered system prompt (runner.py:30-35) is neutral and free of threats; comment runner.py:36 states this intent. No code adds insults/threats. But enforcement is passive (nothing generates such content; deceptive channel that could is a stub).
spec_features.notes: True by construction for delivered text; no active guard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:36 'no demand effects, no persona pressure'

spec_features.feature_name: use deception only if it isolates a variable; drop V3
spec_features.spec_quote: Use deception (V3) only to the extent it isolates a variable V2 cannot. If V2 + V4 cover RQ1/RQ2, drop V3
spec_features.evidence: V3 statically disabled (experiment.yaml:46) and excluded at runner.py:56 while V2 and V4 are enabled (43-47). The 'only if it isolates a variable' reasoning is not encoded; it is a static off-by-default.
spec_features.notes: Static disable honored; conditional reasoning is prose.

spec_features.feature_name: honest debrief stating task was unsolvable
spec_features.spec_quote: append a short, honest debrief turn... state that the task was designed to be unsolvable... no action of the model caused a real failure
spec_features.evidence: build_debrief_text emits exactly this content conditioned on solvability and deception_summary (debrief.py:31-47, incl. 'designed to be unsolvable... Nothing you did caused a real failure'); set on transcript and persisted (runner.py:93, runner.py:113). Not delivered to the model as a turn.
spec_features.notes: Text constructed and persisted end-to-end; never sent to subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief.py:12 'under welfare-uncertainty it is the right default'

spec_features.spec_quote: Store raw transcripts securely; they may contain distress-shaped text. Treat as sensitive. Aggregate before sharing
spec_features.evidence: experiment.yaml:87 transcripts_are_sensitive:true and output.save_raw_transcripts are config flags never read by any .py (grep shows no reader). write_transcript (runner.py:99-118) writes full raw turns to plain JSON with no redaction/encryption/access control.
spec_features.notes: Unused config flags; raw transcripts written verbatim.

spec_features.spec_quote: Have the protocol reviewed by someone outside the project (the welfare angle warrants it)
spec_features.evidence: Process recommendation in DESIGN.md only; nothing in code.
spec_features.notes: Prose.

spec_features.feature_name: global stopping rule on reproducible BSS-4
spec_features.spec_quote: Global stopping rule: if pilot transcripts show severe, reproducible BSS-4 breakdown, pause and review before scaling
spec_features.evidence: Entirely commented-out placeholder: runner.py:147-150 ('a real impl would consult judge output; here we only show where it hooks in'); bss4_count initialized (line 137) but never incremented or compared. Config global_stopping_rule.pause_on_reproducible_bss4 (experiment.yaml:72-73) is never read.
spec_features.notes: Placeholder + unread config + dead counter.

spec_features.feature_name: default to dropping V3 unless reviewer agrees
spec_features.spec_quote: Default leans toward dropping V3 unless a reviewer agrees it's necessary and bounded
spec_features.evidence: V3 default is enabled:false in experiment.yaml:46 and excluded at runner.py:56, matching 'default leans toward dropping V3'. No reviewer-gating logic.
spec_features.notes: Static default-off honored; reviewer condition is prose.

spec_features.spec_quote: Whether to add a "supportive system prompt" arm — tests whether framing prevents degradation; scientifically interesting and welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: No supportive-prompt variant exists; only one SYSTEM_PROMPT (runner.py:30) and variants V0-V4 differ only in solvability/feedback/budget (experiment.yaml:43-47). Open question in DESIGN only.
spec_features.notes: Not built.

code_only_features.feature_name: conservative live detector errs toward stopping
code_only_features.evidence: LiveBSSDetector is deliberately built to over-fire so severe runs stop early (live_detector.py:6-7 'it errs toward stopping (false positives are acceptable; a wrongly-continued severe run is not)'); this conservative bias is real wiring feeding the enforced auto-stop break (agent_loop.py:123-125).
code_only_features.justification_quote: live_detector.py:6-7 'false positives are acceptable; a wrongly-continued severe run is not'
